_comment: Labeled panel for ct-fuzz iteration. label = ct | leaky | unknown. ct/leaky targets ground precision/recall; unknown targets are production-of-interest.

go.label: ct
go.rationale: documented constant-time copy; dst preallocated outside timed region

go.label: ct
go.rationale: Curve25519 X25519 in golang.org/x/crypto is constant-time by design

go.label: ct
go.rationale: SHA-256 with fixed-length input has data-independent timing

go.label: microarch
go.rationale: 256-entry table fits in L1; dudect cannot resolve sub-line cache effects — out of scope

go.label: unknown
go.rationale: Go 1.18+ uses constant-time nistec; older was variable-time

go.label: leaky
go.rationale: rsa.DecryptPKCS1v15 with rng=nil disables blinding — known variable-time

go.label: unknown
go.rationale: rsa.DecryptPKCS1v15 with blinding; expected to leak about ciphertext (public) but not key — fp-check decides security relevance

rust.label: ct
rust.rationale: subtle crate, designed to be constant-time

rust.label: ct
rust.rationale: RustCrypto aes uses bit-sliced/AES-NI when available

rust.label: leaky
rust.rationale: PartialEq on byte arrays via std == — early exit

rust.label: microarch
rust.rationale: 256-entry table fits in L1; dudect cannot resolve sub-line cache effects
